artifact: PHASE 4B §3-§4 - what the Phase-4A reference resolver actually did, and what Phase 4B replaced it with
legacyResolverStatus: RETAINED for Phase-4A fixtures and tests; never used when a strict resolver is supplied

unsafeConstructsInLegacyResolver.why: a null period on either side matched anything, so a fact from the wrong period could satisfy a period-specific reference
the first array element that matched won, so array order decided which fact was used
identity was a bare name, so two companies' facts were interchangeable
an unreviewed number was indistinguishable from an approved one

integration: InputResolver gained an optional `strict` member. The evaluator prefers it and falls back to the legacy resolver, so every Phase-4A test keeps passing unchanged.
